## Changes
- **One frame behind every tab** – all tabs (Overview, Downloads, Calendar, History, Requests, Add, Logs, Settings) now sit on the same rounded background frame. It is 70 % transparent, so the dynamic background (poster wall, library images, aurora, …) stays visible around the cards while the cards stand out more clearly. On phones the frame is slimmer.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.12.1   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.12.0...v1.12.1
